t2.text: Direction A: one layout, skins and volume control as data

n1.text: All three follow the H590 front: matte black, a white OLED readout with the source on the left and volume 0–99 on the right. No Hegel logo or trademarked artwork. 'H590' is shown only as the connected model name.

n2.text: Owner 2026-11-16: start from A, no input knob. Volume = click wheel or slider. A skin is a data file (colours, readout font, control type), so users can add their own. Try the Skin and Control tweaks on the Main artboard.
